svc-fencing.introText: When you need to secure your property, enhance privacy or add a decorative touch, the right fencing makes all the difference. As trusted fencing contractors in Hitchin and the surrounding areas, we supply and fit fences to the highest standards, and we're on hand for fence repairs whenever you need us.
svc-fencing.whyText: Whether it's a residential garden or a commercial property, we offer a wide range of styles to suit your needs, from traditional close board and Venetian fences through to classic larch lap designs. Every project starts with a conversation about what you actually want, and we plan, design and install with an eye for detail and a commitment to doing it right the first time.
svc-fencing.includedListHtml:
• Decorative Fences — enhance your property's appearance with intricate designs like Venetian and wrought iron fencing, often tailored to match your landscape
  • Post and Rail Fences — classic rural design, often used on farms and large properties for boundary definition
  • Privacy Fences — including larch lap, traditional close board and overlap panel fencing, built with no gaps to provide maximum privacy and often used to enclose back gardens
  • Modern/Contemporary Fences — sleek designs that offer a blend of function and style, using up-to-date materials and layouts
  • Chain Link Fencing — a durable, affordable option ideal for security purposes without obstructing the view
  • Palisade Fencing — comprising vertical metal or wooden stakes, a strong option often used around commercial properties
  • Weldmesh Fencing — highly resistant to weather and vandalism, a great option for securing industrial and commercial areas
  • Security Fencing — robust designs that prioritise safety, ideal for businesses or properties needing high security
  • Bamboo Fencing — an environmentally friendly option that offers a unique, natural appearance, often used for decorative purposes
  • Composite Fencing — crafted from a mixture of wood and plastic, it offers the appearance of wood with lower maintenance
  • PVC Fencing — a lightweight, cost-effective option that is resistant to weather and easy to maintain
  • Trellis Fences — often used as decorative additions or to support climbing plants, adding a garden charm
  • Picket Fences — a timeless design featuring spaced vertical boards, often used to define front garden boundaries
  • Feather Edge Fences — built with tapered boards that create a solid wall, providing strong boundaries and privacy
svc-fencing.builtText: As well as fencing, we supply and install a full range of gates, along with specialty fencing to complete your boundary.
svc-fencing.builtListHtml:
• Entrance Gates — the first impression of your property, available in various styles like decorative gates to match your aesthetic
  • Garden Gates — secure your garden without obstructing its beauty, in designs that complement your outdoor space
  • Driveway Gates — enhance your property's entrance, providing added security and style, including automatic and electric options
  • Pedestrian Gates — specifically designed for foot traffic, often found near pavements or public paths
  • Security Gates — robust construction with locks and additional security features to protect property entrances
  • Farm-Style Gates — traditional wooden or metal designs, used to secure farm entrances or rural properties
  • Boundary Fences — clearly define property lines, customisable to match the look of your property
  • Noise Barrier Fences — engineered to reduce noise from traffic or other sources, improving the comfort of your property
  • Windbreak Fences — designed to shield against strong winds, enhancing outdoor comfort
svc-fencing.setsApartListHtml:
• Family-Run Business — decades of honest, quality workmanship across Hitchin and the surrounding areas
  • 30+ Years' Experience — hundreds of satisfied fencing customers
  • Tailored Approach — every job, big or small, handled with the same care and craftsmanship
  • Free, Honest Quotes — competitive pricing with no obligation
svc-fencing.finalCta: Let us show you why we're a trusted choice for fencing in Hitchin. Get your free quote now.

ourStory.heading: Welcome to Pine Landscapes
ourStory.body:
Welcome to Pine Landscapes. Owned by Mark and backed by more than 30 years of experience in the industry, we are all about honest work, integrity and outstanding results.

We are a family-owned business based in the Hitchin area, working right across Hertfordshire and Bedfordshire. Every project is approached with care, whether it is a straightforward repair, a new patio, upgraded fencing, fresh turfing or a complete garden transformation. We treat each job as if it were our own property, and we aim to leave every customer genuinely pleased with the finished result.

Our team is skilled, motivated and committed to doing the job properly. From the initial groundwork through to the finishing details, we focus on practical workmanship, quality materials and a result that is built to last. If you want to see more of our past work and customer feedback, you can also visit our MyBuilder profile.

faq.heading: Your Questions, Answered.
faq.subheading: Got a question about working with us? Here are the ones we hear most.

items.q: Where is Pine Landscapes based and what areas do you cover?
items.a: Based in Hitchin, Pine Landscapes provides professional landscaping services throughout Hertfordshire and Bedfordshire. We regularly work with homeowners and businesses across both counties, from smaller local projects to complete garden transformations. If you are based in Hertfordshire or Bedfordshire and are unsure whether we cover your particular town or village, simply get in touch. We are happy to let you know whether we can help with your project.

items.q: What landscaping services do you provide?
items.a: We provide a comprehensive range of landscaping services for gardens and outdoor spaces, including fencing, decking, paving and turfing, along with the associated preparation and landscaping work needed to complete a project properly. Whether you are looking to improve one particular area of your garden or completely transform your outdoor space, we can tailor the work to suit your property, requirements and budget.

items.q: How much experience does Pine Landscapes have?
items.a: Pine Landscapes is a family-run landscaping company with more than 30 years of industry experience. Over that time, we have worked on a wide variety of gardens and outdoor spaces throughout Hertfordshire and Bedfordshire. Our experience allows us to advise customers on practical solutions as well as appearance, helping you choose materials and designs that will work well for your property and how you intend to use your outdoor space.

Yes. We provide free, no-obligation quotes for landscaping projects across Hertfordshire and Bedfordshire. We can discuss what you are looking to achieve, assess the work involved and provide a quotation based on the requirements of your project. Every garden and property is different, so speaking to us about your plans is the best way to get an accurate idea of the work and costs involved.

items.q: Do you take on both small and large landscaping projects?
items.a: Yes. We are happy to undertake projects of all sizes, from smaller repairs and individual improvements through to substantial landscaping projects and complete garden makeovers. You do not need to be planning an entirely new garden to contact us. If there is simply one part of your outdoor space that you would like repaired, replaced or improved, we will be happy to discuss it with you.

items.q: Can you help with a complete garden transformation?
items.a: Yes. If your garden needs more than one type of landscaping work, we can help bring the different elements together as part of a wider transformation. This can be particularly useful when you want to create a more attractive, practical and usable outdoor space rather than tackling each element separately. We can discuss what you would like from the finished garden and help you consider the most suitable combination of landscaping features, materials and finishes for the property.

items.q: Can you help me decide what would work best in my garden?
items.a: Yes. You do not need to have every detail decided before contacting us. If you know that you want to improve your garden but are unsure about the most suitable materials, layout or approach, we can talk through the available options with you. Our experience across a wide range of landscaping projects means we can offer practical advice based on the space you have, the look you want to achieve, how the garden will be used and your available budget.

items.q: Do you supply the materials as well as carry out the installation?
items.a: Yes. We can supply the materials required for your landscaping project as well as carrying out the professional installation. We use quality materials selected to suit the particular job and the finish you are looking to achieve. Having the supply and installation handled together can also make the overall project much simpler, as you do not need to organise multiple contractors or source all of the materials yourself.

Yes. Pine Landscapes stands behind the quality of its workmanship, and our work is fully guaranteed. Our aim is to provide landscaping that not only looks good when the project is completed but is also professionally installed and built to last. We take pride in providing a reliable service and maintaining a high standard of workmanship throughout every stage of the project.

items.q: How do I get started with my landscaping project?
items.a: The easiest way to get started is to contact Pine Landscapes and tell us a little about what you would like to achieve. Whether you already have a clear idea in mind or simply know that your garden needs improving, we can discuss your requirements and the next steps. From our Hitchin base, we work throughout Hertfordshire and Bedfordshire and are happy to discuss both small landscaping jobs and larger garden transformations before providing a free quotation for your project.
